name: Brisbane
housing: Brisbane renters live in apartments and units, and in timber 'Queenslander' houses raised on stumps.

localRules.text: In Queensland the bond must be lodged with the Residential Tenancies Authority within 10 days of being received.
Queensland tenancies start with the RTA's entry condition report (Form 1a), which the tenant checks, signs and returns within 7 days.

climate: Test the air conditioning and fans and check for mould; Brisbane summers are hot, humid and stormy.
fact: Many older Brisbane homes are timber Queenslanders raised on stumps.
